svg.title: Fall Fairy Garden — step 5: Let your garden tell a story
svg.desc: Arrange a winding stone path, a leaf garden or a tiny twig bench. Add paper fairies if you want, or leave space for imagined visitors. Use the examples for ideas, then add your own colours and details.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A path, a garden and a story of your own.
